name: self-evolve
description: The agent's self-improvement loop: nightly runs that find real defects and make at most one verified root-cause change, a night-drained backlog, a same-day repair loop, and a measured fitness landscape with noise-aware selection over time.
env_example: # self-evolve: notify via Telegram (optional — ntfy package takes priority if configured)
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 019_self_evolve.sql, hot-loads the app, registers the four tick jobs).

How it works: a nightly agent job (02:00) inspects the live system and makes at most ONE focused, verified, root-cause change — or nothing; everything it finds but does not do goes to a backlog that the night drain works item by item (low priority, until the drain cutoff hour); a 15-minute repair tick reacts to terminal failures; a 30-minute tick samples the fitness landscape and judges each change against the metric it declared (kept / regressed / confounded, fix-forward — never auto-revert).
Enable it when you are ready: PUT /api/self-evolve/settings with {"enabled": true} — the package ships disabled, and the nightly and meta runs no-op until it is on.

Watch: GET /api/self-evolve/stats (overview), GET /api/self-evolve/backlog (the loop's backlog with Adopt/Dismiss overrides), GET /api/self-evolve/metrics/outcomes (what each change measured to). The dashboard's Self-evolve section shows the same.

Notify is off until a channel exists: set NTFY_TOPIC (with the ntfy package) or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID; with neither, POST /api/self-evolve/notify answers 503 and the loop simply stays silent.
